name: Icon

sources.dimensions: Footprint from snapshot. Facade widths, setbacks, reveals, roof subdivisions and floor spacing are derived from the cited exterior views; these are not survey measurements.
sources.placement: https://www.iconataustin.com/; 2200 San Antonio Street. ArcGIS World GeocodeServer address match score 100 at -97.743084597282,30.285294489137. 28x30m envelope derived from facade bay counts and neighbor spacing; former Intervarsity footprint is retired, not reused as tower plan.
sources.photos2026: Owner photos 2026-09-14 (tower dusk, crown, context) + icon__south-elevation__02.jpg (Rhode Partners' photograph, frontal) and the owner's dusk aerial, 2026-09-16; colours sampled from it

colours._src2026: Sampled from icon__south-elevation__02.jpg (Rhode Partners' photograph, frontal) and the owner's dusk aerial, 2026-09-16: tower field #d0cecc in shade, lifted to the daylight white; grey piers #bbbbbb; floor ledges #b5b8b5; taupe window heads #746052; the podium's accent panels rust #95654f, brown #6d5a4f, olive #77705f, violet-grey #7c7583, pale grey #aaa8a9, blue-grey #7084a0, taupe #897366. The old wall was tan (#c5b597); every photograph shows white.

iconTower._src: tower (floors 6-30), icon__south-elevation__02.jpg (Rhode Partners' photograph, frontal) and the owner's dusk aerial, 2026-09-16: a white field; a grey concrete pier every THIRD window bay (big bays ~8.2 m of three ~2.72 m bays); a grey ledge at every floor; each window ~1.35 x 2.05 m under a taupe head ~0.4 m; the windows stand in straight vertical columns (the dusk aerial at full size; a stagger read as noise from 70 m).

iconPodium._src: floors 2-5, icon__south-elevation__02.jpg (Rhode Partners' photograph, frontal) and the owner's dusk aerial, 2026-09-16: a bolder white grid, a proud white pier on EVERY bay line and a white band at every floor; one big ~1.55 x 1.8 m window per bay under a taupe head, and beside it on the left a ~0.5 m panel in one of seven colours, picked per bay and storey (and sometimes plain white). The panel stands on the viewer's LEFT of the window; this face's s runs right-to-left seen from outside, so the file says 'right'. It runs the whole storey between the white bands (2026-09-17, street photo).

crownGlass._src: owner crown photo: a faceted glass room with slim white mullions ~1.1 m apart and a white head band
